summary: Frontend-only regression test for iteration 4 (company rename Al MAAN → Alamaan Exchange / ALAMAAN EXCHANGE, issue date June 2026 → September 2026, PDF quality bump to scale=3 / jpeg 0.97 / compression NONE / letterRendering). Verified text changes are 100% applied and live UI renders correctly. PDF download works (149 pages, 128.63 MB, Alamaan-Exchange-Feasibility-Study.pdf). Word download works (Alamaan-Exchange-Feasibility-Study.docx, 1.67 MB). Chapter-divider quality bug (blur/artifacts on big numbers) is FIXED — rendered page 100 shows sharp, artifact-free '17' number and clean gradient background. However, the WORD-CUTOFF bug is NOT fully fixed: on the cover page (PDF page 1) the bottom band ('Alamaan Exchange', 'September 2026', 'Confidential') is visibly clipped and the sub-line 'SULTANATE OF OMAN · MUSCAT · ENGLISH EDITION' is missing from the PDF although it is fully visible on the live site. All other pages I sampled (2, 3, 5, 15, 25, 38, 50, 75, 100) look sharp with no cutoff.

ui_bugs.issue: Cover page content (specifically the bottom footer block: 'PREPARED FOR / Alamaan Exchange', 'ISSUE DATE / September 2026', 'CLASSIFICATION / Confidential' and the 'SULTANATE OF OMAN · MUSCAT · ENGLISH EDITION' line) is clipped in the exported PDF. Root cause: PDF export forces el.style.height=297mm and overflow:hidden on every .a4 page (App.js 105-108) then addImage stretches the captured canvas to exactly 210×297 mm. The cover page's real DOM height exceeds 297mm at the current viewport, so html2canvas captures a canvas whose true content is taller than the locked box → bottom is truncated. Rendered PDF page 1 confirms visible truncation of the last text row.

issues: Final PDF is 128.63 MB for 149 A4 pages (scale=3 + jpeg 0.97 + compression NONE). That is ~860 KB per page. Users with slow connections / email attachments may find this impractical. Consider compression 'FAST' or jpeg 0.92 if size becomes a concern — quality is currently overkill for most pages.

action_items: Fix cover-page cutoff in PDF export. Options: (a) in handleDownloadPDF, capture the natural el.scrollHeight instead of hard-locking height:297mm; then compute pdfImgHeight = 210 * (canvas.height / canvas.width) and either fit-to-page (letterbox) or split across multiple PDF pages. (b) Alternatively, tighten the .a4 cover-page CSS so its intrinsic height is ≤297mm at the render viewport (reduce top/bottom padding on the cover, or shrink the title illustration container). Only the cover page needs this treatment — all other pages fit correctly.
(Optional) Reconsider whether 128 MB is desirable; scale=2.5 or jpeg 0.92 still gives visibly sharp output at a fraction of the size.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js handleDownloadPDF: forcing height:297mm + overflow:hidden guarantees any page with intrinsic height > 297mm will silently truncate content. There is no assertion/logging comparing el.scrollHeight to 297mm before capture — add a dev-mode warning so authors catch overflowing pages during content edits.

App.js line 137: pdf.addImage uses compression 'NONE' with scale=3 and quality 0.97 → 128 MB output. This is a very heavy tradeoff; consider a parameterised 'quality preset' toggle instead of hard-coding max quality.
Cover page footer strip ('PREPARED FOR / ISSUE DATE / CLASSIFICATION' block) is the specific overflow zone — verify at 1440px viewport that .cover .a4 total height is ≤1123px (=297mm at 96 dpi).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (5/6 test items pass; PDF-cutoff item partially fails on cover page only)

context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF generated file was saved at /tmp/test_output.pdf (128 MB, 149 A4 pages, jsPDF 4.2.1). Rendered sample images: /tmp/pdfimg/p001-001.jpg (COVER — shows cutoff at bottom), p002-002.jpg (Notice — OK, shows September 2026 correctly), p005-005.jpg, p015-015.jpg, p025-025.jpg, p038-038.jpg (figure page with photo), p050-050.jpg, p075-075.jpg, p100-100.jpg (Chapter 17 divider — sharp, NO blur, fix confirmed). Word file: /tmp/test_output.docx (1.67 MB). No 'Al MAAN' / 'AL MAAN' residue anywhere. 'September 2026' present, 'June 2026' absent. No JS console errors during PDF or Word export. Live UI screenshot in .screenshots/cover_bottom2.png confirms the missing PDF line ('SULTANATE OF OMAN · MUSCAT · ENGLISH EDITION') IS present on the live cover — so the bug is strictly in PDF export, not in the source content.
rca_of_the_issue: In /app/frontend/src/App.js handleDownloadPDF (lines 104-108, 137): each .a4 element is force-styled to height/minHeight/maxHeight = 297mm with overflow:hidden, then html2canvas captures it, then pdf.addImage(imgData, 'JPEG', 0, 0, 210, 297) stretches the captured bitmap to exactly A4. For every regular page the intrinsic DOM height equals 297mm so nothing is lost. But the cover page's DOM (large hero title + large kiosk image + tri-column footer + subline) naturally lays out TALLER than 297mm at the render viewport; overflow:hidden then clips the bottom pixels before html2canvas ever sees them. Result: bottom ~30-40 px of the cover (containing the 'SULTANATE OF OMAN · MUSCAT · ENGLISH EDITION' line and the descenders of the row above) are erased in the PDF. Reproduction: click [data-testid=pdf-download-button] on the live site, open page 1 of the resulting PDF and compare to the on-screen cover. Mitigation: (1) do NOT force overflow:hidden on capture; instead capture at natural height and either scale-to-fit A4 (letterbox) or paginate the cover onto multiple A4 pages, OR (2) reduce the cover page's inner spacing/hero-image height in CSS so its intrinsic layout height is ≤297mm at the reference viewport, OR (3) apply a scale transform on the .a4 clone inside html2canvas so it fits within 297mm.
